button.title: Argus {version} is ready. Click to see what's new and install it
button.availableTitle: Argus {version} is available. Click to see what's new

menu.dismiss: Don't remind me about this version

dialog.earlier: Notes for earlier versions are on GitHub.
dialog.empty: There are no release notes to show. They're on GitHub.
dialog.language: Release notes are written in Chinese.
dialog.hint: Installing requires administrator permission. Argus closes briefly and reopens on the same page when the installation finishes.
dialog.portable: The portable version doesn't update automatically. Download the new version from the release page.

service.title: Update the privileged service?
service.body: The privileged service is version {serviceVersion}, which doesn't match Argus {version}. Some features may not work. Updating requires administrator permission.
service.bodyOlder: The privileged service is an older version that doesn't match Argus {version}. Some features may not work. Updating requires administrator permission.
service.restoresTaskManager: Updating first restores Windows Task Manager; the replacement can be turned on again in Settings afterwards.
service.done: The privileged service has been updated.
